safety.v115_policy: Feature files are materialized with git show, copied only to /tmp on source host/container, compiled/imported from temp, Production Accounting and BC are read only, Mongo persistence disabled, /app unchanged, no restart.

safety.v115_variable_vendor_guard: No vendor-specific or route-name override. A learned route can be selected only from repeated same-vendor Accounting labels with a strong score margin, discriminating evidence, at least two supporting labels, and a contract-valid target; otherwise the route fails closed to review.
safety.v116_policy: Balanced labels are read directly from GamerAccounting AP Temp, raw nested placements are retained for audit but learned labels resolve to contract-valid intake queues, corpus persistence is false, feature files remain temp-staged, held-out prompts are bounded to eight train-only examples, Business Central is read-only, /app is unchanged, and no runtime restart or Production write is permitted.

notes: V115 is validated parity evidence for the AI learning mechanism. V116 first broad run discovered 2,913 live labeled files but stopped before held-out routing because the harness confused nested Accounting work/archive folders with intake destinations. The feature now preserves raw placement while resolving supervised labels to the nearest contract-valid intake queue, retains verified dynamic order routes only with BC evidence, and skips PDF supporting-page parsing for image primaries. V116 is ready for a clean retest.
